source: https://atct.anl.gov/api/v1/covariance/species/ (ATcT API v1, through the atct Python client 1.0.1), fetched 2026-11-11T01:45:43Z
sd_units: kJ/mol; sd = sqrt(API covariance diagonal), the ATcT 95 % uncertainty of DfH(298.15 K), TN 1.228 (median ratio to the printed value 0.987)

cut.rule: pair dropped when 2|r| sd_i sd_j < tau * (sd_i^2 + sd_j^2 - 2|r| sd_i sd_j) or when r rounds to 0; r rounded so rounding changes var(x_i -/+ x_j) and the minimum over k of var(x_i - k x_j) by <= 0.5 %

coverage.target_rule: gas-phase species with <= 3 non-hydrogen atoms, larger gas-phase species ranked <= 800, and named common ones
